title: Victoriocity
subtitle: Alternate-Victorian detective comedy with real momentum under the jokes.
description: A detective comedy drama || Even Greater London, 1887. In this vast metropolis, Inspector Archibald Fleet and journalist Clara Entwhistle investigate a murder, only to find themselves at the centre of a conspiracy of impossible proportions.
